page.overview:
What is Team Skull?

Team Skull is a street gang that appears in Pokémon Sun and Pokémon Moon. The group was founded by Guzma. It started out as an antagonistic group until it became a reformed allied gang during since the incident of Team Rainbow Rocket in the update Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon.

Team Skull is stated to not actually have a uniform, instead wearing casual clothes which were made and owned by the grunts themselves with a Hip-hop, Street vibe. The clothes are mainly black, and white with a skull helmet and their emblem hanging from a necklace/chain. Male grunts have blue hair and female grunts have pink hair, it's implied they dye their hair.

The male grunts wear loose black tank tops with an X shaped cross design at the bottom in white, baggy knee length shorts with white zig-zag designs on the sides, white sneakers and black bandanas. The female grunts wear similar outfits, wearing torn white shorts and knee length black socks with white sneakers.

Team Skull is encountered many times in the course of the story. They are mostly bugging people and stealing rare Pokémon. They try to steal berries from a man, but the player character stops the two grunts. Two grunts are also encountered at the Verdant Cavern trial and turn out helping the player character by blocking the two other holes where the wild Pokémon hides in.
